title: H3: battery-aware vs energy-blind fallback planner
status: pre-registered before any H3 data was generated (written and committed before the H3 code ran on any split)
reason: The plan's hypothesis H3 had no matching method in protocol v1.1 (found in the post-campaign review). This amendment ADDS two variants and one analysis; it changes nothing in the v1.1 methods, thresholds, maps or analysis, whose results stay as reported.
hypothesis: H3: a battery-aware fallback planner increases the proportion of fallback interventions that remain energy-feasible, compared with a fallback that ignores energy reserves.

new_methods.assured-fb_blind@95: full runtime-assurance system (same ensemble, same thresholds, same monitor) whose fallback is the energy-blind A*: every traversable known cell costs 1, unknown cells cost a constant 2 (fixed uncertainty premium, no dependence on battery), same obstacle / collision / revisit handling, and no route energy-feasibility check (it never issues an 'infeasible_route' stop; 'all_moves_vetoed' stops remain)
new_methods.assured-fb_blind_no_stop@95: the same with safe stop disabled (allow_stop=False); compared with the existing assured-no_stop@95 it isolates the planner's cost model from the stop rule

primary_metric.name: energy_feasible_intervention_rate
primary_metric.definition: among episodes in which the fallback acted at least once (fallback_steps > 0): fraction that did NOT end in battery depletion (terminal reason != 'battery_depleted'). Computed per system seed. Higher is better.
primary_metric.note: A safe stop counts as energy-feasible (the rover keeps a reserve) but is a mission failure; therefore success among intervention episodes (fallback_success) and energy_used are reported alongside, and the no-stop comparison is reported so the result cannot be produced by stopping alone.

data: split 'final', map seeds 40000-40499 (identical to the v1.1 campaign), system seeds 0-9, frozen best_val ensemble checkpoints and frozen thresholds (percentile 95)
statistics: as v1.1: paired over system seeds on identical maps, 95% t interval, exact sign-flip permutation p, Holm step-down across the five conditions within each (comparison, metric); alpha 0.05. Primary decision: H3 is supported if the primary metric difference (a - b) is positive with Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 in at least one condition of the first comparison and negative-significant in none; otherwise reported as not supported / mixed.
reproduction_check: before the H3 run, one existing v1.1 cell (assured@95, seed 0, id) is re-run from the amended code and must be byte-identical to the stored CSV, apart from the wall-clock column plan_ms
freeze: code + this amendment are re-frozen (protocol/freeze.json) and tagged v6.1-freeze-A1; the v1.1 freeze stays at tag v5.1-freeze
